name: In'yoku ~Youkoso Ingyaku no Hanazono e~
original_name: 淫慾 ～ようこそ淫虐の花園へ～
source:
An office worker Daimokuni Kenichi sees the women president Reiko getting in a taxi. He tracks her down to the SM club "Dorothy" where he enlists as well to see her humiliation. 

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2017/11/vn-of-month-november-1999.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
上班族大木国健一看到女社长丽子坐上了出租车。他跟踪她到了SM俱乐部“Dorothy”，他也加入了那里，看看她受到的羞辱。

[来自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2017/11/vn-of-month-november-1999.html]vndbreview[/url]]
